::: {.content-hidden when-format="pdf"}
::: {.hidden}
<!-- Math macros of the sheets: latex-math's combined.qmd (generated from its .tex
files), read by Pandoc as raw TeX and applied to every formula, in the HTML and the
PDF. The definitions themselves would also reach the LaTeX output, so they must stay
in this block, which is hidden in the PDF. (combined.qmd starts and ends with a stray
$$; its blank lines keep that from turning the definitions into math.)
The two lines below map what sheets write in their own formulas (e.g. \bm in I2ML's
nn.qmd, \mathds as in the slides): combined.qmd only maps its own uses, and neither
MathJax nor Quarto's LaTeX template knows these commands. -->

%%% START: additionally to latex-math, we need this
\renewcommand{\bm}{\boldsymbol}
\renewcommand{\mathds}{\mathbb}
%%% END

{{< include /../latex-math/combined.qmd >}}
:::
<div id="solution-buttons-header">

<script>
// "Show All Solutions" / "Hide All Solutions": opens or closes every solution
// block (.sol) and everything nested in it; hints outside solutions stay as they are
function toggleAllSolutions() {
  const sols = document.querySelectorAll('.sol details');
  const open = !Array.from(sols).every(d => d.open);
  sols.forEach(d => { d.open = open; });
  const btn = document.getElementById('toggle-solutions-btn');
  btn.textContent = open ? 'Hide All Solutions' : 'Show All Solutions';
  btn.classList.toggle('btn-success', open);
  btn.classList.toggle('btn-danger', !open);
}

// The R/Python tabsets form one Quarto tabset group (group="language"):
// selecting a tab selects that language in every tabset, and Quarto keeps the
// choice for the next sheet. "Only R" / "Only Python" just select such a tab.
// (theme.scss hides both buttons on sheets without these tabsets.)
function showLanguage(lang) {
  const tab = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.panel-tabset[data-group="language"] .nav-link'))
    .find(a => a.textContent.trim() === lang);
  if (tab) tab.click();
}
</script>

::: {.content-visible when-profile="solution"}
[Show All Solutions]{.btn .btn-danger .btn-sm role="button" id="toggle-solutions-btn" onclick="toggleAllSolutions()"}
:::

[[Only R]{.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm role="button" onclick="showLanguage('R')"} |]{data-lang="R"}
[[Only Python]{.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm role="button" onclick="showLanguage('Python')"} |]{data-lang="Python"}
[Print]{.btn .btn-secondary .btn-sm role="button" onclick="window.print()"}

</div>
:::
